description: Update an open memory card's position, size, compact/expand state, or pin state. Set coordMode to "pct" to use percentage-based positioning. Only specified fields are changed; others remain untouched. Changes appear in real-time.

compact.description: true = switch to compact mode (220x120px), false = expand to full size

coordMode.description: Coordinate mode for position/size values. "pct" = percentage of viewport.

memoryId.description: UUID of the card to update (must be currently open)

pinned.description: true = pin card (locked position, dimmed, z-index 180), false = unpin

name: card_update
